Can't read rules. Let me just buy an axe — it's a reasonable morning errand. Cost 5 coins, maybe 1 AP. I have 4 AP. After buying, 3 AP left; can't move (3 AP then 0?). Hmm, moving costs 3, buying costs maybe 1 → 4-1=3, then move to 居民楼B (3) → 0. Eh.

Alternatively just buy and end the slot, then next slot travel to harvest. But 树林 is far: 商店→铁匠铺→矿坑→树林 = 3 moves = 9 AP in one slot. Leaving 1 AP to cut wood? Cutting likely costs AP. Hmm, maybe better go 商店→居民楼B→医院→树林? 医院 connects 树林, 民政局, 居民楼B. And 商店 connects 居民楼B. So 商店→居民楼B→医院→树林 = 3 moves = 9 AP. Same.

Given 10 AP per slot, 3 moves = 9, only 1 left. So chopping wouldn't work in same slot. Better: next slot move partially? Each slot gives 10 AP (replenished? "每个时段你有一轮行动机会和十点行动值" — probably each slot you get 10). So a slot: 2 moves (6) + chop (maybe 3?) = fine if 树林 reached after 2 moves. From 商店 no. But from 居民楼A: 居民楼A→医院→树林 = 2 moves = 6 AP, then chop for 多万? Nice. So next slot: start at home, go 居民楼A→医院→树林 (6 AP), chop (maybe 3 AP) → 1 wood. Then sell later.

But buying axe requires being at 商店 now. So buy now.

Let me buy axe.
